\section{Overview}
\subsection*{hwde-led-test - brief}
The Hive's first hwde board: a tiny, quick test run that proves the pipeline goes from requirements to checked KiCad files inside the Hive. It is not to be ordered; ordering stays the person's.

A tiny 2-layer board that lights one LED from 5 V.

\begin{itemize}
\item Input: 5 V DC (4.75-5.25 V) on a 2-pin 2.54 mm pin header, J1: pin 1 = +5V,
pin 2 = GND. From a bench supply or a USB 5 V lead. No reverse-polarity
protection wanted (the LED itself blocks reverse current; a test board).
\item One green LED, 0603, lit at about 3-5 mA through one 0603 series resistor.
\item One 0603 ceramic capacitor (1-10 uF, \textgreater{}= 10 V) across the input, at J1.
\item Parts from the JLCPCB basic library wherever one fits; SMD parts on the top
side only, for JLCPCB assembly; the header may be through-hole.
\item Board: 2 layers, 1.6 mm FR-4, HASL, as small as practical (about 15 x 12 mm
is fine, no HARD cap), no mounting holes, no enclosure.
\item Quantity if ever built: 5. Room temperature, bench use.
\end{itemize}
\section{Requirements}
\subsection*{hwde-led-test - requirements}
\subsubsection*{1. Function}
A tiny 2-layer test board that lights one green 0603 LED from a 5 V DC input through one 0603 series resistor, with one 0603 ceramic input capacitor at the input header. Its purpose is to prove the hwde pipeline runs from requirements to checked KiCad files inside the Hive. It is not to be ordered; ordering stays with the person. No declared mode (normal design).

\subsubsection*{2. Interfaces}
\begin{itemize}
\item J1: 2-pin 2.54 mm pin header (through-hole allowed). Pin 1 = +5V, pin 2 = GND.
Fed from a bench supply or a USB 5 V lead.
\item D1: one green LED, 0603, lit at about 3-5 mA.
\item No debug connector, no MCU, no buttons, no other I/O.
\end{itemize}
\subsubsection*{3. Power}
\begin{itemize}
\item Input: 5 V DC, range 4.75-5.25 V, on J1.
\item No reverse-polarity protection (stated: the LED blocks reverse current; test board).
\item One rail only (+5V). LED current target 3-5 mA via one 0603 series resistor
(value to be chosen at design time from the LED Vf; ASSUMED: LED Vf about 2.0-3.0 V
for green, so roughly 470 ohm-1 k ohm).
\item Input capacitor: one 0603 ceramic, 1-10 uF, \textgreater{}= 10 V, across the input at J1.
\item Total load about 5 mA max (guess). No battery, no charging.
\end{itemize}
\subsubsection*{4. Environment}
Room temperature, bench use. No enclosure, no ingress, no vibration requirement.

\subsubsection*{5. Size \& mounting}
\begin{itemize}
\item Outline: as small as practical, about 15 x 12 mm is fine. SOFT target, no HARD cap.
\item Mounting holes: none. No enclosure.
\item Height limit: none stated.
\item Stackup: 2 layers, 1.6 mm FR-4, HASL.
\end{itemize}
\subsubsection*{6. Quantity \& budget}
Quantity if ever built: 5. Target unit cost: not stated (ASSUMED: not a constraint).

\subsubsection*{7. Assembly}
JLCPCB PCBA. SMD parts on the top side only (single-sided SMD assembly); the header J1 may be through-hole. Use JLCPCB basic-library parts wherever one fits.

\subsubsection*{8. Compliance/safety flags}
None apply: no mains, no battery, no motors, no voltage above 30 V, no current above 3 A, no RF transmit. (5 V DC input, about 5 mA load.)

\subsubsection*{9. Open questions}
none

\subsection*{Design review of record}
\subsection*{hwde-led-test - P8 board review (verify-reviewer, fresh context)}
Inputs: reports/checks/summary.json (14/14 checks ran, none skipped, 2 warnings), reports/verify-gate.json (PASS), renders reports/renders/hwde-led-test\_top.png, hwde-led-test\_bottom.png, hwde-led-test\_iso.png (review set, w 2400), reports/hwde-led-test-schematic.pdf, requirements.md, architecture/, kicad/constraints.json, parts/parts.json.

Result: 0 errors, 3 warnings. Nothing found that stops this board working on the bench.

\subsubsection*{Findings (worst first)}
1. WARNING, silk: J1 polarity is not marked (hwde-led-test\_top.png, \_iso.png). The J1 silk is a plain rectangle with no "+", "5V" or "GND". Pin 1's square pad shows only on the bottom (hwde-led-test\_bottom.png) and is hidden under the header's plastic on top. requirements.md section 3 drops reverse protection because "the LED blocks reverse current". With the leads swapped, D1 sees about 5.25 V reverse (C1 and R1 take it with no problem). Green InGaN 0603 LEDs are usually rated VR = 5 V, and parts.json carries no VR for KT-0603G. Marking the pins is the cheap protection. Fix: "+" / "-" text at J1 pins 1/2. The bottom side is empty, so B.SilkS fits easily.

2. WARNING, fab: the board is below JLC's minimum board size for PCBA. The outline is 13.05 x 9.08 mm. reference/jlc\_capabilities.yaml records a 10 x 10 mm board minimum, and requirements section 7 says JLCPCB PCBA. The board also has no fiducials. Fix it at the fab step: panelize with rails (JLC puts the fiducials on the rails), or grow the outline to 10 mm or more in Y (placement or outline fit). The P6 decision to fit at 2 mm margin was recorded and section 5 is a soft target, so the size itself is not drift. Only the PCBA minimum is the issue. The board is not to be ordered now, so this is a warning.

3. WARNING, silk: the C1 refdes is ambiguous (hwde-led-test\_top.png). The "C1" text sits at about (15.2, 22.3), under the gap between R1 and D1 and roughly equidistant from C1, R1 and D1. Move it beside C1.

\subsubsection*{Hunt list, cleared}
\begin{itemize}
\item Connector mating: J1 is a vertical 2.54 mm header with mating from above (iso render). Nothing tall
is near it. C1 (0.8 mm tall, pad edge at about 12.7 mm) is clear of a 2.54 mm Dupont housing
(header body edge at 12.17). J1 is centred on the left edge as constraints.json asks
(edge left, pos 0.5: J1 y 20.2 = board centre).
\item Polarity after assembly: the D1 outline has a chamfer at the cathode end, outside the body, so it
stays visible after assembly. Footprint pad 1 = K = GND matches symbol pin 1 = K and
the schematic. The small diode glyph inside the outline is hidden under the body (not a defect).
\item Cross-artifact: all requirements interfaces are present (J1 +5V/GND, D1 green 0603, R1 0603,
C1 0603 4.7 uF 16 V X5R at J1). All three architecture blocks are present. No mounting holes, as
stated. 2 layers. SMD top side only. The change from R1 680R (architecture) to 470R is a recorded P3
decision (real Vf 3.1 V, giving 3.5-4.6 mA over 4.75-5.25 V, inside the 3-5 mA promise), so it is not drift.
Schematic, PCB and parts.json values match. D1 is a JLC extended part. parts.json records that no
basic 0603 green exists (only an 0805 one), so that is justified.
\item Return path and decoupling: +5V runs J1.1 -\textgreater{} C1.1 -\textgreater{} R1 (the input cap is in the path). C1 GND drops
through a via at (13.2, 21.74) to the B.Cu GND pour, about 2.3 mm from J1.2, which is thermal-tied
to the pour. D1 cathode has its own via. This is fine at 5 mA.
\item EMI, RF, crystal, switcher, thermal: none on this board.
\item Routing visual: straight runs and 45-degree runs only. The +5V path steps down into C1's pad and back
up to R1, which is deliberate (it routes through the cap pad). It is not a needless detour.
\end{itemize}
\subsubsection*{Warning triage (verify\_all)}
\begin{itemize}
\item check\_route\_style jog, /LED\_A F.Cu (17.06, 18.975), 0.15 mm sidestep: a real but cosmetic defect.
R1 pad 2 is at y 18.9 and D1 anode at y 19.05. The cheapest fix is to move D1 from
(18, 19.8) to (18, 19.65) so the trace runs straight (placement, then reroute that one net).
A waiver is also acceptable for a test board. Recommendation: fix it if anything else
is touched, otherwise waive.
\item check\_ratings rating\_unrated D1, R1: RECOMMEND WAIVER. R1 does carry a rating
("Voltage-Supply(Max)" 75 V) that the checker did not recognise. It sees at most 5.25 V. D1 is
forward-biased in normal use (about 3.1 V). Its only overstress case is reverse polarity, which is
handled by finding 1 and listed under OPEN.
\end{itemize}
\subsubsection*{Waivers recommended (human decides at checkpoint 4)}
\begin{itemize}
\item check\_ratings D1/R1 (reason above).
\item route\_style jog on /LED\_A, only if the D1 nudge is not taken.
\end{itemize}
